column103: Business days with no active trade are included as zero returns.
column104: Transaction costs, financing, and borrow fees are not deducted.
column106: Daily target/acquirer price P&L using the selected hedge ratio; the final day reconciles to the observed settlement return when available. Otherwise the market-to-deadline path is retained as an explicit fallback.
column107: Mean daily return / daily standard deviation * sqrt(252), zero risk-free rate.
column112: All-tradable and completion-only are identical in this run because the executable historical blotter contains no terminated or withdrawn events.
column124: Sizes and entry capacity include our market impact, but final settlement accepts the historical election result.
column125: capacity_raw_max_* is flow/ADV/position supply. capacity_max_* is the largest tradable size that still passes the risk gates after our self-impact. capacity_optimal_* maximizes expected dollar PnL over the same feasible grid.
column126: Final completed-state election demand is shifted by q*(our election cash probability - counterparty cash probability) for ENTER. REVERSE keeps passive blended liability because it has no election right.
column137: Under fixed-pool passive blended settlement, reverse payoff is not destroyed by its election-demand shift because the short side has no election right and blended completion liability is demand-independent.
column224: Cross-sectional realized-return diagnostics on the completed-election sample. Deal breaks are absent from realized election returns, so mean/std and Sortino are sensitivity statistics, not investable or annualized strategy ratios.
column248: PASS/REVIEW rows have no executed capacity; missed/review profitability uses the selected marginal realized return already printed in arb_signals.csv.
